# Image color palette

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/image-palette/

Extract a small set of dominant colors from a photo or screenshot. Copy HEX codes to reuse a visual mood in a website or design.

## How to use it

1. Choose a clear, supported image from your device.
2. Adjust the image settings and run the tool.
3. Inspect the preview, then download or copy the result.

## Example

Find six colors in a landscape photo and use one as an accent in a presentation.

## Limits and checks

The palette uses sampled pixels and color grouping. It is a design aid rather than an exact inventory of every color.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
